name: Calamine

indications: Skin protectant that dries the oozing and weeping of poison ivy, poison oak and poison sumac (FDA OTC label, Active ingredients / Purpose / Use).

dosage.adult: Shake well before using. Apply as needed to the affected area (FDA OTC label, Directions).
dosage.maximum: The label does not set a fixed maximum; Directions say 'apply as needed'. Stop use and ask a doctor if the condition worsens, if symptoms last more than 7 days, or if symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days (FDA OTC label, Directions and Warnings).

fields.adult_dosing: Shake well before using. Apply as needed to the affected area. For external use only (FDA OTC label, Directions and Warnings).
fields.monitoring: Self-limited: stop use and ask a doctor if the condition worsens, if symptoms last more than 7 days, or if symptoms clear up and occur again within a few days (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
fields.patient_counselling: Shake well before using and apply as needed. For external use only and do not get into the eyes. Keep out of reach of children; if swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Stop use and ask a doctor if the condition worsens or symptoms last more than 7 days, or if symptoms clear and then come back within a few days. Store at 59 to 86 degrees F (FDA OTC label, Directions; Warnings; Other information).
warnings: For external use only (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Do not get into eyes (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Stop use and ask a doctor if the condition worsens (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Symptoms last more than 7 days, or clear up and occur again within a few days, requires asking a doctor (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Keep out of reach of children (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
precautions: For external use only - not for ingestion or application to mucous membranes (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Avoid eye contact (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Supervise children and keep the product out of reach of children (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
Store at 59 to 86 degrees F (FDA OTC label, Other information).
Shake the bottle well before each use so the suspended ingredients are evenly distributed (FDA OTC label, Directions).
fields.overdose: If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (FDA OTC label, Warnings). The label gives no other overdose information.
clinical_pearls: Composition: calamine 8% plus zinc oxide 8%; a skin protectant for drying the oozing and weeping of poison ivy, oak and sumac (FDA OTC label, Active ingredients / Purpose / Use).
Sold under OTC Monograph M016 (skin protectant) as a topical suspension; calamine lotion must be shaken before use because the ingredients settle (FDA OTC label, Directions; Marketing Information).
Inactive ingredients include bentonite magma, calcium hydroxide, glycerin and purified water (FDA OTC label, Inactive ingredients).

The label reports no contraindications, no serious adverse reactions, and no drug, food, pregnancy or lactation information; treat systemic concerns (ingestion) by contacting a Poison Control Center (FDA OTC label, Warnings; Adverse reaction section is unpopulated).
NOT for systemic, oral or ophthalmic use; external use only. Stop and seek medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen (FDA OTC label, Warnings).
brand_names: SWAN Calamine Lotion (Calamine topical Suspension USP), Nice-Pak Products, LLC; distributed by Consumer Product Partners, LLC (FDA OTC label, Principal Panel Display and Product Information).
fields.administration_instructions: Shake well before using; apply as needed to the affected area. For external use only — avoid the eyes, keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center. Store at 59 to 86 degrees F (FDA OTC label, Directions; Warnings; Other information).

notes: The row stores 'Calamine'. This monograph is sourced from the FDA DailyMed OTC monograph (M016) label for CALAMINE- calamine, zinc oxide lotion (Beauty/Nice-Pak Products, LLC; SWAN brand, distributed by Consumer Product Partners, LLC), setid c370ee1f-1887-44e8-8d47-8ffa3c270ff5, updated September 2026. It replaces an earlier draft that put a DailyMed setid in place of the database row id and cited a different (mismatched) product and setid (a calamine plus pramoxine product) in every source. The label is a plain OTC skin-protectant monograph: it states active ingredients (calamine 8%, zinc oxide 8%), use (dries the oozing and weeping of poison ivy, oak and sumac), warnings (external use only, avoid eyes, stop and ask a doctor if the condition worsens or symptoms last more than 7 days or recur, keep out of reach of children, if swallowed get medical help or call Poison Control), directions (shake well; apply as needed) and storage (59 to 86 degrees F). It contains no mechanism-of-action, contraindication, side-effect, interaction, pregnancy, lactation, pharmacokinetic, renal or hepatic dosing information; those fields are therefore null and are listed in unsourced_fields rather than filled with invented content. Empty arrays (serious_adverse_reactions, food_interactions, black_box_warnings) record that the label states none and do not overwrite existing database content on apply. The earlier draft's claims about children under 2, flammability, pramoxine and 'PLLR-style' pregnancy text were not in this label and have been removed.
